scoring_justification: Recomputing DFT wavefunctions or running the full quantum chemistry calculation inside the verifier sandbox is infeasible; the checker compares the agent's reported property values to the paper's published reference numbers with tolerances that absorb toolchain spread.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for structural parameters, WBI, NPA charges, AdNDP occupation numbers, and IQA interaction energies of the D3h SiSb3Ca3+ cluster.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 1 (bond distances, WBI, NPA charges), text (AdNDP σ and π ON ≈ 2.0), Table 2 (IQA interaction energies) of the paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly copied from the paper's reported data; no synthesis.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the quantitative results published by the authors; the checker verifies the reproduction against these values.

outputs.description: Computed structural, bonding, charge, and energetic properties of the D3h SiSb3Ca3+ cluster. Checked against hidden reference values derived from the paper, with tolerances appropriate for DFT re-runs.

output_contract.notes: IQA fields (V_Total, V_Ionic, V_Coval) are encouraged but not required; if missing they score 0 for the IQA portion. The required fields must be present. All values are numeric; units are indicated. The hidden checker compares each field to reference values with predefined tolerances.
